svg.text: Wiring diagram - LMS robot (ESP32 + TB6612FNG + 3S LiPo)
Pins follow Appendix A so the firmware matches. Warning marks = see pin notes (bottom right). Ground symbols all join at the star point (bottom left).
Ground topology: star point at battery -
Pin notes for real WROOM-32 hardware (marked !)

g.text: ! GPIO11 (IN4 -> BIN2) is an SPI-flash pin and will not work on a real board.
Remap to GPIO4: change the IN4 constant in line_follower.ino, move one wire.
! GPIO12 (IN3 -> BIN1) is a boot-strapping pin. OK here because the TB6612 input
has an internal ~200 kOhm pull-down, so it stays low at reset. Never add a pull-up.
! GPIO25 (S5) is an ADC2 channel: unreadable while Wi-Fi is on (BLE is fine).
GPIO34/35 are input-only: fine for sensors, never use them as outputs.
Encoders use GPIO16-19 (free, not in Appendix A), powered at 3.3 V so the signals
never exceed the ESP32's 3.3 V limit. STBY is tied to 3V3 (could go to a spare GPIO).
